newsitem.title: USA: Mark reports loss, retains Bear Stearns.
newsitem.headline: Mark reports loss, retains Bear Stearns.

text.p: Mark Centers Trust on Wednesday reported a fourth-quarter loss of $0.08 per share, and said it engaged Bear Stearns & Co Inc to explore strategic alternatives.

The self-administered equity real-estate trust said it lost $675,000 on revenues of $11.3 million, compared to a profit of $839,000, or $0.08 per share, on revenues of $11.3 million for the same period a year ago.
For full-year 1996, Mark Centers lost $724,000, or $0.08 per share, on revenues of $43.4 million. In 1995 it had a profit of $3.8 million, or $0.44 per share, on revenues of $43.0 million.

Mark Centers said its funds from operations amounted to $3.1 million in the fourth quarter of 1996, or $0.30 per share, compared to $3.9 million, or $0.38 per share, for the same period the year before.
Operating income for the full year was $12.4 million, or $1.22 per share, compared to $15.3 million, or $1.50 per share, in 1995.
Mark Centers was trading down 1/4 at 11-1/2 on Wednesday.
